dem.source: USGS 3DEP via The National Map 3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage (best available, resampled bilinear to 1.0 m)

conventions.bearing: compass degrees true of the tee line (tee -> 270-yd point)
conventions.along_pct: + = ground rises going away from the tee (upslope landing)
conventions.cross_pct: + = ground rises to the golfer's right (ball kicks left)
conventions.fall_line: direction of steepest descent, deg clockwise from the tee line (0 = straight away, 90 = to the right, 180 = back toward the tee)
